title: A Torn Shirt Proved the Truth

meta.name: v5_y12_07_the-torn-shirt
meta.title: A Torn Shirt Proved the Truth

lines.text: A torn shirt told the truth.
A witness from her family points to the shirt.
And they both raced to the door, and she tore his shirt from the back, and they found her husband at the door.

quran.ar: وَٱسۡتَبَقَا ٱلۡبَابَ وَقَدَّتۡ قَمِیصَهُۥ مِن دُبُرࣲ وَأَلۡفَیَا سَیِّدَهَا لَدَا ٱلۡبَابِۚ

lines.text: But if his shirt is torn from the back, then she has lied, and he is of the truthful.

quran.ar: وَإِن كَانَ قَمِیصُهُۥ قُدَّ مِن دُبُرࣲ فَكَذَبَتۡ وَهُوَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِینَ

lines.text: Stay honest, and the details will back you.
The truth is in the details.
